build_BasicTransform: build a BasicTransform 3D conv block with Tx3x3 and 1x3x3 kernels for video feature extraction
build_BottleneckTransform: build a BottleneckTransform 3D conv block with Tx1x1, 1x3x3, and 1x1x1 kernels for video processing
build_X3DTransform: build an X3DTransform block with depthwise Tx3x3 conv and optional SE attention for video recognition
build_ResBlock: build a ResBlock residual block with skip connections and optional dropconnect for video models
build_ResStage: build a ResStage with multiple ResBlocks and optional nonlocal layers for multi-pathway video networks
